\section{SDF Ground Truth Pipeline}\label{sec:appendix_sdf_pipeline}

\paragraph{Mesh processing.}
For each SafeLIBERO scene, we extract all visual meshes from the MuJoCo XML model. The \texttt{spatial\_bowl} scene contains 68 meshes (19 initially watertight); \texttt{object\_chocolate} contains 60 meshes (13 initially watertight). Robot arm meshes (complex multi-part geometry) remain non-watertight and are excluded from SDF computation, as the SDF field targets scene obstacles only.

\paragraph{SDF computation.}
Query points are sampled via dual-scale Gaussian ($\sigma_1{=}0.025$, $\sigma_2{=}0.008$, 80\% near-surface) plus 20\% uniform within the bounding box, yielding 4,084 points per scene.
